cities.intro: Stay in one neighbourhood. The city is many small towns.
Wood, moss, and the sound of a kettle. Walk slowly, eat early.
Loud, generous, unbothered. Eat standing up, then find the quiet.
Mountains on every side. Matsumoto, Karuizawa, and the roads between.
Fuji on one side, vineyards on the other. Rent a car, drive slowly.
An hour from Tokyo, a century away. Sea on one side, hills on the other.

places.note: Ryue Nishizawa, one curving floor, trees inside. Rain suits it.

places.name: Chihiro Art Museum Azumino
places.note: Picture books and a field of the Alps. Good with children, better without.

places.name: Matsumoto City Museum of Art
places.note: Yayoi Kusama was born here. The tulips outside are hers.

places.name: Kaichi School
places.note: 1876, a Japanese carpenter's idea of a Western school.

places.name: Marumo Coffee
places.note: Kissaten since 1956. Pudding and a river view.

places.name: Sawamura Bakery
places.note: Breakfast on the deck by the stream.

places.name: Zenkoji morning service
places.note: Be there before dawn. Then the shops open with the light.

places.name: Togakushi cedar approach
places.note: Two kilometres of 400-year-old cedars. Soba at the end.

places.name: Obuse town walk
places.note: Chestnut town where Hokusai spent his last years. Open gardens.

places.name: Nakamachi Street kura
places.note: White storehouses, folk-craft shops, one good soba.

places.name: Hoshinoya Fuji
places.note: Cabins in a forest facing the lake. Fires at night.

places.name: Risonare Yatsugatake
places.note: Mario Bella's arcade in the woods. Easy base for the wineries.

places.name: Kiyoharu Art Village
places.note: Tadao Ando's chapel, a Yoshio Taniguchi museum, cherry trees. Nearly empty.

places.name: Nakamura Keith Haring Collection
places.note: A dark building in a light forest. Odd and worth it.

places.name: Kubota Itchiku Art Museum
places.note: Kimono as landscapes, in a Gaudí-like garden.

places.name: Grace Wine
places.note: Koshu, the grape Yamanashi is known for. Tasting room by the vines.

places.name: Château Mercian Katsunuma
places.note: Old winery buildings, a small museum, lunch on the terrace.

places.name: Kosaku Hoto
places.note: Flat noodles in miso and pumpkin. What the mountains eat.

places.name: Oshino Hakkai at opening
places.note: Eight spring ponds. Before 8am it's a village; after, a bus stop.

places.name: Kawaguchiko north shore
places.note: Fuji across the water, best in the hour after sunrise.

places.name: Fujiyoshida Honcho street
places.note: Old textile town, Fuji filling the end of the street. Sunday afternoon.

places.name: Kiyosato highlands drive
places.note: Larch forests, cows, soft-serve. Feels like somewhere else.

places.name: Kamakura Kokon
places.note: Two rooms in a 1920s house. Breakfast is the reason.

places.name: WeBase Kamakura
places.note: Beach hostel with a yoga floor. Cheap and clean.

places.name: Kamakura Museum of Literature
places.note: A 1936 villa above a rose garden. Kawabata's Kamakura.

places.name: Hokokuji
places.note: Bamboo garden, matcha at the back. Arrive at opening.

places.name: Meigetsuin
places.note: The round window. Hydrangeas in June, empty in February.

places.name: Café Vivement Dimanche
places.note: Kamakura's coffee living room since 1994. Brazilian records.

places.name: Kamakura Bergfeld
places.note: German rye and pretzels. Take them to the shrine steps.

places.name: Paradise Alley Bread & Co
places.note: Sourdough from a market stall covered in paint.

places.name: Matsubara-an
places.note: Soba in an old house with a garden. Sake first.

places.name: Moyai Kougei
places.note: Folk craft from all over Japan, in a house on a quiet lane.

places.name: Inamuragasaki at sunset
places.note: Enoshima and Fuji in one frame. Then onsen next door.

places.name: Enoden to Enoshima
places.note: Sit on the sea side. Get off wherever looks right.

places.name: Daibutsu hiking trail
places.note: Ninety minutes through the hills. Ends at the Buddha.
